title: In some cases, there may be issues with cropping the captured bounding box.
author: gaoxing64
summary: A Grab And Move report on a Windows 11 Insider build supplies before-and-after screenshots of a captured bounding box but does not describe the capture sequence or the observed cropping error.

judgment.rationale: The report identifies the product area, version, operating-system build, and visual examples, but the empty actual-behavior field and absent steps do not establish which capture mode, window state, or selection operation produces the cropped result. The existing upstream automated-triage comment requests the same missing reproduction evidence.
evidence: The report targets Grab And Move in PowerToys v0.101.2432 Preview installed through auto-update.
The reporter supplied screenshots under Steps to reproduce and Expected Behavior, but supplied no textual steps or actual behavior.
The issue is labeled Needs-Author-Feedback and Needs-Triage and has no assignee, linked issue, linked pull request, or reporter follow-up.
The existing automated-triage comment specifically asks for concrete reproduction steps.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact capture sequence and a description of the selected versus resulting bounding box before attempting reproduction or a code-level fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked fix attempt exists. A PowerToys selection or coordinate-conversion defect is plausible, but the current report cannot identify the failing capture path or support an implementation change.

proposed_fixes.title: Identify and correct the Grab And Move bounding-box crop path
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Unproven: the captured bounding box may be calculated or transformed incorrectly for a particular capture mode, window arrangement, or display scaling state.
plan: Use the reporter's exact steps to reproduce the selection and resulting crop on the reported PowerToys and Windows builds.
Determine whether the incorrect bounds originate when the capture rectangle is selected, converted between coordinate spaces, or cropped into the final image.
Add a narrowly scoped correction and regression coverage only after the failing path and expected bounds are confirmed.
verification: Repeat the reporter's capture sequence and confirm that the final image contains the selected bounding box.
Retest the confirmed capture mode with the reported display arrangement or scaling configuration.

confidence.rationale: The screenshots suggest an incorrect crop, but no reproducible interaction sequence or actual output description identifies the responsible path.

issue_context.summary: The reporter observes a potential Grab And Move capture crop discrepancy on a Windows 11 Insider build, illustrated only by screenshots.
known_information: The report identifies Grab And Move, PowerToys v0.101.2432 Preview, auto-update installation, and Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 29639.1000.
Two images were supplied, one under steps and one under expected behavior.
No actual-behavior text, bug-report ZIP, assignee, or linked fix is present.
inferences: The selected and output bounds may differ, but the screenshots alone do not establish the capture mode or the stage at which the discrepancy occurs.
An Insider-build or display-configuration interaction is possible but is not established by the report.
issue_context.analysis: A maintainer cannot reproduce a visual selection defect without knowing the initiating gesture, target content, and expected versus resulting bounds. The requested details directly determine whether the issue belongs in selection handling, coordinate conversion, or image cropping.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, labels, assignees, automated-triage comment, and visible timeline references.
Found no linked or cross-referenced upstream pull request or issue that establishes an existing fix or duplicate.

information_gaps.information: Numbered steps beginning with how Grab And Move is invoked, the target window or content, the selection gesture, and the point at which the captured result is viewed.
information_gaps.why_needed: They identify the capture path a maintainer must exercise to reproduce the error.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the exact sequence used to create the two screenshots.

information_gaps.information: A short description or annotated image showing which part of the selected bounding box is missing, shifted, or unexpectedly included in the actual captured result.
information_gaps.why_needed: It defines the expected output and distinguishes a selection-boundary defect from an output-cropping defect.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Annotate the existing screenshots or attach a new before-and-after pair with the incorrect region marked.

actions.label: Request reproduction details

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshots and the Windows Insider build details. To reproduce the Grab And Move crop problem, please provide the numbered sequence you used: how you opened Grab And Move, the window or content you captured, the selection gesture, and where you viewed the result. Please also mark or describe the part of the selected bounding box that is missing, shifted, or unexpectedly included in the captured image. Those details are needed to determine whether the problem occurs while selecting the bounds or while producing the final crop.
